relations.subject: Charles Elliott
relations.role: agent to the Governor-General at the Court of the Great Moghul
relations.evidence: he was sent to Delhi as senior member of the Board of Revenue of the North Western Provinces, and agent to the Governor-General at the Court of the Great Moghul... These qualities rendered him a fit and able successor to Sir Charles, afterwards Lord, Metcalfe.

relations.subject: Henry Ellis
